title: Dallas residential electrical final checklist
text_content: Verify GFCI and AFCI protection where required. Confirm panel directory is complete and legible. Ensure final trim is installed and service grounding is complete before requesting final approval.

title: Dallas service upgrade release guidance
text_content: Service release inspections require disconnect labeling, grounding electrode completion, and safe clear access to the meter and disconnect area for the inspector.

title: Dallas reinspection access note
text_content: Reinspection visits should only be requested when the site is accessible, the responsible contact is reachable, and prior correction items are fully addressed.
